$comment: L5 canon-as-data: the MindAttic.Components web/ component catalog (formerly MindAttic.Web.Shared's). codex front-matter equivalent: { codex:1, project:MindAttic.Components (web), code:MAU, layer:data, status:living, updated:2026-10-13 }. Schema: _schema/component.schema.json. Paths are relative to web/. Prose (BIBLE/README) cites these by id; do not restate fields. Folders verified on disk 2026-10-13 (32 components).

components.name: Cyberspace
components.summary: Cyberpunk console-background effects engine: 12 named effects, scan-line overlay, parallax circuit board, content keepout zones.

components.name: SacredGeometry
components.summary: Catalog of 1024 animatable line-art shapes; one pure renderer to live <canvas> or static SVG; build-previews.mjs emits one poster per shape.

components.name: Hyperspace
components.summary: Standard library of the 159 Hyperspace exhibits (stable ids, plaque metadata, geometry, pure projection for Three.js and 2D canvas) plus the Hyperspace Reader scanner window.

components.name: OutfitFont
components.summary: Outfit variable font: woff2 files in fonts/, @font-face by pinned CDN URL (outfit-font.cdn.css) or inlined as base64 (outfit-font.css), plus the --font-outfit token.

components.name: AtticFont
components.summary: Attic display face: woff2 in fonts/, @font-face by pinned CDN URL (attic-font.cdn.css) or inlined as base64 (attic-font.css), plus the --font-attic token.

components.name: PinFooter
components.summary: Pin-when-short footer: toggles position:fixed bottom:0 on .pin-when-short while the document is shorter than the viewport.

components.name: BackHomeM
components.summary: A capital M in AtticFont pinned upper-left, linking back to mindattic.com; used on satellite sites.

components.name: WebSnapshot
components.summary: Capture a fresh screenshot of any URL with Playwright, cover-fit + crop it, and inline the result as a base64 data URI in any .web-snapshot container.

components.name: PageScrollbar
components.summary: Themed, draggable overlay scrollbar replacing the native browser scrollbar; Blazor razor wrapper for flash-free SSR; CSS-var themeable under .ma-scrollbar*.

components.name: Textbox
components.summary: Angular-Material-style outlined text field with floating label (Material notch effect); themeable via CSS vars; pairs with OutfitFont --font-outfit token.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Standalone, dependency-free, accessible tooltip driven by data-tooltip attribute; one reused floating node; namespaced under .ma-tooltip*; optional Blazor wrapper.

components.name: UserLogin
components.summary: Styling wrapper around the MindAttic.Authentication MaLogin static-SSR form; scoped CSS under .ul-card; Blazor Razor wrapper; does not implement authentication.

components.name: UserCircle
components.summary: Authenticated-only avatar/initials circle (upper-right); click opens a menu or signs out; reads ClaimsPrincipal via AuthorizeView; logout via native form+AntiforgeryToken.

components.name: UserTimeout
components.summary: 30-minute idle-timeout warning + auto-logout; countdown modal; renders and arms only when authenticated; logout via native form+AntiforgeryToken; static-SSR safe.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The base MindAttic button, .ma-btn on an <a> or <button>; pages add their own look as local CSS on top.

components.name: CaptureDemo
components.summary: Decides when a page runs its hands-free demo: ?demo=1, or the MindAttic.Capture bridge reports the session is being filmed.

components.name: VideoEmbed
components.summary: Click-to-play YouTube: a 16:9 poster swapped for the youtube-nocookie player only when clicked; no YouTube code loads before.

components.name: HashPages
components.summary: Several pages in one document (section.ma-page), switched by data-page links without a reload; the URL hash follows.

components.name: ThemeFx
components.summary: Canvas engine the theme effects draw with: one full-screen #fx-canvas, adaptive quality, and the Channel Change transition.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: .ma-toolbar: sticky themed bar with __label.

components.name: ToolButton
components.summary: .ma-tool-btn (--primary, --block) and .ma-tool-link.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: .ma-icon-btn: 32x32 icon button (--fixed).

components.name: Select
components.summary: .ma-select: themed select.

components.name: Range
components.summary: .ma-range: themed range slider.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: .ma-menu dropdown panel with __group and __item (--active).

components.name: Modal
components.summary: .ma-modal overlay with __dialog, __header, __title, __close, __footer.

components.name: Lightbox
components.summary: .ma-lightbox (.is-open) with __inner, __links, __img.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: .ma-tag pill with a hover tip __tip (--below); tag.js (MindAtticTag.init) builds the tip on first hover, flips it below near the top and keeps it on screen with --tt-arrow-x.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: .ma-progress + __fill; --edge for a thin bar along a container bottom.

components.name: FormRow
components.summary: .ma-form-section__title, __rows, .ma-form-row, __label, __value.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: .ma-avatar round image (--ma-avatar-size).

components.name: SkipLink
components.summary: .ma-skip-link: keyboard skip-to-content link.
